entities.summary: Gaetano Chiaveri was an Italian architect and master builder, most notable for his work as part of the second phase of the Dresden Baroque. His works include the Cathedral in Dresden and a new wing of the Royal Castle in Warsaw. In the Russian Empire, he oversaw the construction of Kadriorg Palace to Nicola Michetti's designs.
